page.layout: One page of text. Top: a tree diagram under the running head, headed "Dispositio lib. 2." Below it: a smaller diagram with a bracket on the left. Then the division heading "M. T. Cic. Officiorum Liber III.", a Greek-and-Latin subtitle line, and three paragraphs of running text. A catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Dispositio lib. 2.
M. T. Cic. Officiorum Liber III.
ἀφοριστικῶς[?] ἢ ἀναλυτικῶς tractatus.
main_text.p: I. Atq; hactenus de singulis seorsim; nunc conjunctè deinceps de honesto & utili; sive nimirum honestum quid videatur, quod utile non sit, sive contrà.

p.i: II. Illa enim contentio magnam de officio difficultatem adfert. Ubi generaliter statuendum, nihil honestum, esse, quin utile sit & vicissim.
Quæ Socratis sanctissima illa doctrina, execrantis etiam eos, qui occæcati specie quadam, primùm ista contra naturam distraxissent.

page.notes: The Greek subtitle is printed in a small, worn face; the first word is uncertain and marked [?]. The first word of the italic paragraph ("Quæ") is partly unclear. The diagrams use braces and brackets; the level of each box is read from the drawing. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored. The catchword "III.Quam-" is taken as the catchword at the foot, not as text, because it stands alone at the right below the last line.
